questions.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
questions.worked_solution:
First, we get the minor corresponding to ${c}_{21}$, removing the $2$nd row and the $1$st column:

$$
C=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 2 & 3 & 0 \\ 1 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 2 & 1 & -2 \\ ∗ & 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{21}=|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|.
$$

Therefore, the cofactor of ${c}_{21}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{21} & =(-1)^{2+1}{M}_{21} \\  & =-{M}_{21} \\  & =-|\begin{aligned}2 & 3 & 0 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 0 & 3\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Determinant of a NxN Matrix Using Cofactor Expansion
questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 0 & 0 & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 & -3 \\ -1 & 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A) & ={a}_{11}{C}_{11}+{a}_{12}{C}_{12}+{a}_{13}{C}_{13}+{a}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =(-3)\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+0\cdot {C}_{13}+5\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =-3{C}_{11}+5{C}_{14} \\  & =(-3)\cdot |\begin{aligned}-3 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 3 & -2 \\ ∗ & -1 & 2 & -3 \\ ∗ & 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|+5\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & ∗ & 5 \\ 0 & 0 & 3 & ∗ \\ 4 & -1 & 2 & ∗ \\ -1 & 6 & 0 & ∗\end{aligned}| \\  & =(-3)(-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|+5(-1)^{1+4}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3|\begin{aligned}0 & 3 & -2 \\ -1 & 2 & -3 \\ 6 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}|-5|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 3 \\ 4 & -1 & 2 \\ -1 & 6 & 0\end{aligned}| \\  & =-3(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ 0 & 0\end{aligned}|-3\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & -3 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|-2\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|) \\  & -5(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 6 & 0\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & 2 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}|+3\cdot |\begin{aligned}4 & -1 \\ -1 & 6\end{aligned}|) \\  & =-3\cdot (-3\cdot (0+18)+(-2)\cdot (0-12))-5\cdot (3\cdot (24-1)) \\  & =90-345 \\  & =-255\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating the Determinant of a NxN Matrix Using Cofactor Expansion
questions.problem:
Calculate the determinant of the matrix
$H=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 & -1 & 0 \\ 7 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & 0 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}].$
questions.worked_solution:
We use the cofactor expansion along the first row:

$$
\begin{aligned}det(H) & ={h}_{11}{C}_{11}+{h}_{12}{C}_{12}+{h}_{13}{C}_{13}+{h}_{14}{C}_{14} \\  & =2\cdot {C}_{11}+0\cdot {C}_{12}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{13}+0\cdot {C}_{14} \\  & =2\cdot {C}_{11}+(-1)\cdot {C}_{13} \\  & =2\cdot |\begin{aligned}2 & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ \\ ∗ & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ ∗ & 5 & 0 & 2 \\ ∗ & 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot |\begin{aligned}∗ & ∗ & -1 & ∗ \\ 7 & 0 & ∗ & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & ∗ & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & ∗ & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2\cdot (-1)^{1+1}|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|+(-1)\cdot (-1)^{1+3}|\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2|\begin{aligned}0 & 0 & 0 \\ 5 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 3 & -2\end{aligned}|-|\begin{aligned}7 & 0 & 0 \\ -1 & 5 & 2 \\ 1 & 0 & -2\end{aligned}| \\  & =2(0\cdot |\begin{aligned}0 & 2 \\ 3 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ 0 & 3\end{aligned}|)-(7\cdot |\begin{aligned}5 & 2 \\ 0 & -2\end{aligned}|-0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 \\ 1 & -2\end{aligned}|+0\cdot |\begin{aligned}-1 & 5 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}|) \\  & =2(0)-(7(-10)) \\  & =-(-70) \\  & =70\end{aligned}
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating a Minor in a NxN Matrix
questions.problem:
What is the minor of ${q}_{22}$ in 
$Q=[\begin{aligned}1 & 8 & \sqrt{3} & -1 \\ 3 & 3 & 19 & \sqrt{3} \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & 8 \\ -7 & 4 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}]?$
questions.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${q}_{22}$, we remove the $2$nd row and $2$nd column:

$$
Q=[\begin{aligned}1 & ∗ & \sqrt{3} & -1 \\ ∗ & 3 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 0 & ∗ & 0 & 8 \\ -7 & ∗ & 2 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{22}=|\begin{aligned}1 & \sqrt{3} & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 8 \\ -7 & 2 & 1\end{aligned}|.
$$

questions.knowledge_point: Calculating a Cofactor in a NxN Matrix
questions.worked_solution:
First, to get the minor of ${q}_{55}$, we remove the $5$th row and $5$th column: 

$$
Q=[\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & 2 & 0 & ∗ \\ 3 & 5 & 0 & 9 & ∗ \\ 15 & -1 & -5 & 6 & ∗ \\ 4 & -4 & 3 & 8 & ∗ \\ ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & ∗ & -3\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{55}=|\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & 2 & 0 \\ 3 & 5 & 0 & 9 \\ 15 & -1 & -5 & 6 \\ 4 & -4 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}|.
$$

Now, the cofactor of ${q}_{55}$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}{C}_{55} & =(-1)^{5+5}{M}_{55} \\  & ={M}_{55} \\  & =|\begin{aligned}7 & 6 & 2 & 0 \\ 3 & 5 & 0 & 9 \\ 15 & -1 & -5 & 6 \\ 4 & -4 & 3 & 8\end{aligned}|.\end{aligned}
$$
